mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PARTDASHBOARD(PARTALL, PARTACTIVE, PARTINACTIVE, BATCHDATE, OLS) VALUES( #{partDto.partALL}, #{partDto.partActive}, #{partDto.partInactive}, #{partDto.batchDate}, #{partDto.ols} )
mapper.select: SELECT A.BLOCKNO_NUMBER AS BLOCKNO, COUNT(A.BLOCKNO_NUMBER) AS BLOCKNO_COUNT FROM normalpart$vf A JOIN normalpart$id B ON A.vf$ouid = B.id$last WHERE A.NATION != '2803457356' --중국법인 제외 AND A.PART_STATUS = '2466425004' --활성 AND A.MD$STATUS = 'RLS' --릴리즈 AND SUBSTR(A.BLOCKNO_NUMBER, 2,1) IN ('1','2','3') AND SUBSTR(A.MD$MDATE, 0,4) IN('2025', '2024') GROUP BY A.BLOCKNO_NUMBER ORDER BY BLOCKNO_COUNT DESC
